about: Read by config.routes(). A leg runs on its phase's model and effort (phases.json) unless a route here names its role and phase, and its unit when the route lists units. model: opus or sonnet. A route is a trial until the owner says it stays.

routes.why: the owner, 2026-10-12: every review-fix execute leg runs on Sonnet; the plan leg stays on Opus. It follows the trial of 2026-10-08, six units a side: execute cost $3.93 on Sonnet against $5.93 on Opus, five of six passed in both, in more turns. Guard: read after every ten review-fix units; under eight passes of ten, or a worse fix check, this route goes.

trial, the owner 2026-10-12 (Sonnet for the medium work): can a review fix be PLANNED on Sonnet. Only the model changes, the effort stays the phase's. The ten units are every second one of the next twenty review-fix units in the queue on 2026-10-12; the other ten (rv-17, rv-20, rv-23, rv-25, rv-27, rv-29, rv-31, rv-33, rv-35, rv-37) are planned on Opus beside them as the control. Measured per unit: the plan passes its check, the unit's verdict, the fix check, and the cost of all its legs. Read out after the twenty; under eight passes of ten on Sonnet the route goes.
